title: Full data export as a human-readable, printable PDF packet
description: Wardens trust a physical, readable paper trail more than a zip file they can't open themselves (LODGY-28 exports a DB+photos zip, not something a warden can read or hand to someone). To ease the fear of 'losing everything in the app', offer a printable/PDF export of the underlying records - hostels, tenants, invoices, payments - as a human-readable document, distinct from the machine-readable backup zip. Depends on LODGY-56 (shared PDF rendering foundation) - reuse the same renderer LODGY-37 builds against rather than a second pipeline; this ticket is the larger, multi-page consumer of it.
acceptanceCriteria: Warden can export a printable PDF summary of all tenants, active agreements, and payment history for a hostel (or all hostels)
PDF is legible and organized (grouped by hostel/room/tenant), not a raw data dump
Exported via SAF like other exports (LODGY-23/28), so it can be saved, printed, or shared

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.

Added an explicit dependency on LODGY-56 - this ticket and LODGY-37 both need PDF rendering and were at risk of building two separate, inconsistent pipelines. LODGY-56 builds the shared renderer first; this ticket and LODGY-37 consume it.
